evidence.reason: The dispatch at 2895–2896 routes both `drain-alive` and `drain-ambiguous` into the same `drain_refuse_phase(args)` while `--seed` (2877) is an independent, unconstrained choice. Thus `drain-alive --seed ambiguous` supplies the ambiguous scenario to the shared probe while the result payload/evidence is keyed to `self.phase` (`drain-alive`), so a successful ambiguous probe is recorded as drain-alive evidence — a silently mislabeled proof artifact in a verification driver. The file already encodes the intended invariant for the analogous case: matrix phases reject a conflicting name-derived input at 2886–2889 (`... proves the " + case + " case derived from its name, not --boundary ...`), and nothing performs the same binding for phase-vs-seed. This is a small internal-consistency repair (derive seed from the phase name or reject a conflicting `--seed` as usage before dispatch), not a new requirement or scope expansion, so no owner decision is needed. Severity minor is appropriate because only mismatched manual invocations are affected; normal callers pass the matching seed.
